Situations

You can choose tailored protection before a known incident. A separation, business dispute or inheritance conflict can make the need more immediate.

How private information becomes exposed

Separation
Business dispute
Inheritance conflict

Toza builds your protection around a personal threat model, hardens your devices and accounts, and teaches you the security practices fitted to your circumstances.

How Toza works

Dr. Lior Tabansky works with you personally.

Start a private conversation.

Dr. Tabansky answers personally. The free conversation usually takes 10–20 minutes. You discuss whether anything is urgent and whether Toza fits your circumstances, then the paid assessment as a possible next step. The conversation does not commit you to purchase.
